claim_boundary.conditional_prediction: the q_(3s) handed law and cross-channel closure null
claim_boundary.exact: Z5 fusion/support, connectedness, determinant phase no-go, and invariant I_rst formula
claim_boundary.not_claimed: that the lattice charged row is already a particular loop-CFT primary

exact_character_algebra.connectedness_reason: Every proper nonempty subset of A or B has nonzero Z5 charge, so all one-point and disconnected two-point factors vanish exactly.

mechanism_assumptions: the same deck character basis is transported exactly between the two hands
the same local angular spin-s insertion is used in all three legs
one Hecke eigenfield dominates each of the A and B cubic channels
the marked three-point geometry is matched between the two hands
score_order: score the two-real-component cross-product null first
then rank the frozen H4/H8/H12 q_(3s) joint GLS models
report I_113 and I_122 with joint covariance as phase-gauge-free OPE magnitudes

controls: forbidden nonneutral triples remain exact zero or labeling-error diagnostics
minimal_experiment.geometry: the existing N325 same-parent children (8+i)(2+i) and (8+i)(2-i)
minimal_experiment.insertions: one randomly translated fixed-shape three-anchor pattern per replica; evaluate the existing charged landing-marked local row at all three anchors
minimal_experiment.required_covariance: full 8x8 covariance of real and imaginary parts of four complex channels

normalization_and_phase.interpretation: I_rst is universal without choosing charged-field phases; a complex OPE phase requires an exact transported deck basis or a larger closed fusion loop.
normalization_and_phase.phase_no_go: det=-15 != 0: no nonconstant monomial of only the four primitive cubic coefficients is invariant under independent charged-field rescalings.
